mostWorthwhile.text: Breaking down fat was the most worthwhile action because the result explained the different roles of bile and lipase.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pancreas felt routine on its own because the result gave no explanation; the later organ summary helped give the fittings purpose.

surprise.text: I found the explicit distinction that bile is not an enzyme useful; it clarified how bile and lipase work together.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely arbitrary: the named slots and food-enzyme pairings gave each a clear purpose, although some fittings initially offered little explanation.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the digestion products cross into the body, though I would hope for more explanatory results between the straightforward combinations.
